issue.subject: Remote Resolve triggers 2.4 GHz channel optimization (BCS)
issue.description:
NOC-AUTO S10

**Statement:** As a NOC engineer, I need 2.4 GHz channel optimization triggered when a ticket is remotely resolved, and its outcome recorded, so that the customer's Wi-Fi is improved as part of the resolution.

**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

**ACs (3):**

- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC41` BCS triggered: When the decision is Remote Resolve, 2.4 GHz channel optimization (BCS) is triggered for the CPE.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC42` BCS outcome recorded: The BCS outcome is recorded as Success (new channel), Success (same channel), Failed or Skipped (the existing CPEMS BCS statuses). A Peppermint job that fails with TIMEOUT_BEFORE_SEND is recorded as Failed with that reason. There is no separate Timeout result.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC43` Overall result: The overall automation result has two completed states: TICKET_COMPLETED when the RT ticket was updated (BCS not needed, failed, skipped, pending or not sent), and FULLY_COMPLETED when the RT ticket was updated and BCS succeeded. A failed or skipped BCS leaves the run at TICKET_COMPLETED, with no further RT update.

**Notes / dependencies:** Cross-team: RT Dev owns the trigger, result handling and the webhook receiver (Peppermint sends the webhook to the callback_url that RT supplies, so the receiver runs on the RT side); CPEMS Dev owns the Peppermint API and the webhook sender (Peppermint #22497, cross-project link). Contract: Peppermint v1.2.0-rc.1 (pre-release for QA; the schema can change until the final v1.2.0 tag): release notes https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/cpems/peppermint/releases/v1-2-0 and OpenAPI https://git.frontiir.net/controller/cpems/peppermint/-/blob/v1.2.0-rc.1/openapi.json.

**Open points:**

- AC42: Decided 2026-11-19: no separate Timeout result. If no result arrives, the BCS result sweeper polls after 5 minutes and gives up after 10 (configurable), recording Failed. A failed or skipped BCS leaves the run at TICKET_COMPLETED (decided). Risk: RT's webhook and sweeper recognise only succeeded, failed and unconfirmed, so a Peppermint rc.1 success or skipped is rejected or recorded as failed; RT Dev updates the status handling.

**Implementation status:** code exists on the feature branch, unvalidated. Tasks to be refined by Dev after the Story is agreed.

**Related (reference only):** #21613, #22265, #22497
